redfin.remarks: Welcome to 5340 Wilkinson Ave #5, a 2-bedroom, 2.5-bath towhhome in Valley Village with 1,485 square feet across two levels. Recent updates bring a fresh feel to the interior, including a fully remodeled kitchen with quartz countertops , new cabinetry, garden window and high-end appliances . Wood-look flooring with upgraded baseboards runs through the downstairs living areas, while wood flooring continues up the stairs and throughout the upper level. The light and bright living area has a ceiling to floor corner fireplace . The primary suite features a vaulted ceiling , balcony, en suite bath, and walk-in closet. Side-by-side laundry is conveniently located upstairs. Additional features include two parking spaces in the gated garage, a huge private storage room, and a gated complex with a pool. This home combines updated finishes with practical amenities and a well-planned two-level layout.
